shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [[ -f ../round-brief.md ]]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,220p' && if [[ -f .lore/test-commands.yml ]]; then sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; fi && git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [[ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]]; then echo reanchor-present; fi; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"; git diff --check; git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix beforeSession test traceability" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
